nodes.name: TypeScriptAnalyzer.addSourceFiles
nodes.description: Adds source files to the ts-morph Project using glob patterns. Called before analyze() to define the analysis scope.

nodes.name: TypeScriptAnalyzer.analyze
nodes.description: Main analysis entry point. Performs two passes: first extracts all functions, then builds the call graph by resolving call expressions to known functions.

nodes.name: TypeScriptAnalyzer.createFunctionInfo
nodes.signature: (fn: FunctionDeclaration | FunctionExpression | Node, name: string, filePath: string) => FunctionInfo
nodes.description: Creates a FunctionInfo record from a function declaration or method. Extracts signature, body, and location for storage.

nodes.name: TypeScriptAnalyzer.createFunctionInfoFromVar
nodes.signature: (varDecl: VariableDeclaration, fn: ArrowFunction | FunctionExpression, name: string, filePath: string) => FunctionInfo
nodes.description: Creates FunctionInfo for arrow functions and function expressions assigned to variables. Handles the different AST structure compared to declarations.

nodes.name: TypeScriptAnalyzer.extractCalls
nodes.description: Finds all call expressions within a function and resolves them to known function IDs. Returns deduplicated list of callee IDs for building the call graph.

nodes.name: TypeScriptAnalyzer.extractFunctions
nodes.description: Extracts all function-like entities from a source file: named functions, exported arrow functions, and class methods. Returns FunctionInfo for each.

nodes.name: TypeScriptAnalyzer.getCalleeName
nodes.description: Extracts the function name from a CallExpression AST node. Handles both simple identifiers and property access (obj.method).

nodes.name: TypeScriptAnalyzer.getRelativePath
nodes.description: Converts absolute file paths to paths relative to the project root. Ensures consistent entity IDs across different machines.

nodes.name: createInlineTemplate
nodes.description: Fallback template creator when packaged template files are not found. Writes minimal Claude command templates inline.

nodes.name: findTsConfig
nodes.description: Searches for tsconfig.json or tsconfig.build.json in the current directory. Returns undefined if none found.

nodes.name: getGitCommitSha
nodes.description: Gets the current git HEAD commit SHA. Falls back to a timestamp-based ID if not in a git repository.

nodes.name: GraphStore.close
nodes.description: Closes the database connection. Should be called when done with queries to release resources.

nodes.name: GraphStore.findEntryPoints
nodes.description: Identifies call graph roots - functions that make outgoing calls but receive no incoming calls. These represent system entry points like CLI commands or API handlers.

nodes.name: GraphStore.getAllDescriptions
nodes.description: Returns all stored descriptions. Used by the descriptions command to show documented entities.

nodes.name: GraphStore.getCallees
nodes.description: Finds all functions called by a given entity. Used to trace execution flow downward from entry points.

nodes.name: GraphStore.getCallers
nodes.description: Finds all functions that call a given entity. Essential for impact analysis - understanding what would break if this function changes.

nodes.name: GraphStore.getCommits
nodes.description: Returns all unique commit SHAs in the database, ordered by creation time. Used to list available snapshots for temporal queries.

nodes.name: GraphStore.getDescription
nodes.description: Retrieves the stored description for an entity. Returns undefined if no description has been set.

nodes.name: GraphStore.getEntities
nodes.description: Retrieves all entities from the database. If commitSha is provided, returns entities at that specific commit. Otherwise returns the latest version of each entity.

nodes.name: GraphStore.getEntitiesNeedingDescriptions
nodes.description: Returns entities that need descriptions: either missing entirely or stale (implementation changed since last description).

nodes.name: GraphStore.getEntityById
nodes.description: Retrieves a single entity by ID, optionally at a specific commit. Returns the latest version if no commit specified.

nodes.name: GraphStore.getEntryPoints
nodes.description: Returns entry points with their associated entity data. Entry points define the main flows through the codebase.

nodes.name: GraphStore.getRelations
nodes.description: Returns all relationship edges, optionally filtered by commit. Used for building the full call graph visualization.

nodes.name: GraphStore.insertEntity
nodes.description: Persists a code entity (function, type, etc.) to the database. Uses INSERT OR REPLACE to update existing entities for the same commit.

nodes.name: GraphStore.insertEntryPoint
nodes.description: Marks a function as an entry point (call graph root). Entry points are functions with outgoing calls but no callers.

nodes.name: GraphStore.insertRelation
nodes.description: Records a relationship between entities (calls, uses_type, exports, imports). Uses INSERT OR IGNORE to prevent duplicate edges.

nodes.name: GraphStore.isDescriptionStale
nodes.description: Checks if an entity's description is stale (impl_hash changed since description was written or was never tracked).

nodes.name: GraphStore.isEntityUnchanged
nodes.signature: (id: string, signatureHash: string, implHash: string | null) => boolean
nodes.description: Checks if an entity exists with identical signature and implementation hashes. Used to skip redundant inserts during sync.

nodes.name: GraphStore.setDescription
nodes.signature: (entityId: string, content: string, implHash?: string | null) => void
nodes.description: Stores or updates a description for an entity. Descriptions are AI-generated or manually written and persist across syncs.

nodes.name: createDatabase
nodes.description: Creates and initializes the SQLite database with all required tables (entities, relations, entry_points, systems, descriptions). Sets up WAL mode for better concurrent access.

nodes.name: computeHash
nodes.description: Computes a SHA-256 hash of the input string, returning the first 16 hex characters. Used as the base hashing function for both signature and implementation hashes.

nodes.name: computeImplHash
nodes.description: Computes a hash of function body source text to detect implementation changes. Simpler than AST-based hashing, catches any code modification including formatting.

nodes.name: computeSignatureHash
nodes.description: Computes a deterministic hash for function/type signatures by normalizing whitespace before hashing. Used to detect when a function's interface changes between commits.
